_about: Real FreeWRL window captures. Source PNGs sit beside this file; scripts/make_captures.py writes the web copies. Never edit a capture by hand beyond resizing.

linux-2026-10-01.label: FreeWRL 6.7.0 · Ubuntu 24.04
linux-2026-10-01.detail: FreeWRL 6.7.0 (libfreewrl 6.7.0), local autotools build of Ascendance3D/freewrl, built 2026-09-29. Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, X11, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti, driver 595.91.07, OpenGL 4.6. Window captured with ImageMagick import on 2026-10-01; clip recorded with ffmpeg x11grab. Input from xdotool (mouse drag, Page Down).
